# GENERATED FILE - do not edit by hand.
# Regenerate with tools/city_provinces.py after any change to state province
# lists or to the map.
#
# HoI4 script has no province scope. There is no province iterator and
# has_terrain is COUNTRY scope only ("has any province of this terrain"), so
# "how many city provinces are in this state" cannot be asked at runtime. It is
# therefore measured off the map here and baked into a state variable.
#
# A CITY PROVINCE IS A PROVINCE WITH urban TERRAIN in map/definition.csv -
# the ones that draw as built-up ground. There are 265 of them on the map.
# State membership comes from history/states, with this mod's 19 overriding
# files applied on top of vanilla's, so the province moves this mod makes are
# reflected here.
#
# Only states with at least one are listed. An unset variable reads as 0 in
# HoI4, so every state omitted here correctly counts as having no city.
#
# 233 states have a city province: 204 with one, 26 with two, 3 with three.
#
# Run once from on_startup, guarded by a global flag - province membership
# cannot change during a game, so this never needs repeating.
